result.summary: Found 1 issue: a major content problem where a raw localization key is shown as a section title.

issues.description: Section heading below 'Fastest near you' displays the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title, unlike the correctly rendered heading above it.
issues.suggestion: Fix the localization lookup for this section so the translated string (e.g. 'Popular near you') is rendered, and add a fallback/missing-key check to prevent raw keys from showing in production.
